rationale: I re-hashed and read EO 7677 in the held FR text (2 FR 1581; sha 37a8d36c...). It matches the API/1989 observations (July 27, 1937, Withdrawal of Public Lands for the Use of the Department of Agriculture, Colorado). Section 1 partially revokes EO 6910 for the described Colorado area (a one-time performed command; consequences, not continuing authority). Section 2 temporarily withdraws and reserves the vacant lands for the Department of Agriculture Weld County Project, subject to valid existing rights and mineral-law proviso; section 3 applies the order upon release of prior claims; section 4 says the reservation remains in force until revoked by the President or Congress. No own-terms end exists. The cruden number search found no later held instrument citing EO 7677; EO 7717/7718 appear only because their text says 7677-A (CCC), so their ACT evidence is a false identity lead, not an amendment or end. The 1989 snapshot row groups EO 7677 as not ended, a lead only and not a CURRENT predicate through 2026-10-14. Neither NO (no express revocation, supersession, own-terms expiry or performed one-time command for section 2) nor YES (no held current predicate) is supportable; recommendation left blank rather than guessed.
